instruction: A small octagonal music box with a hinged lid, its entire shell shimmering with iridescent diffraction film. Surfaces shift from teal to violet to gold depending on viewing angle, and a translucent spinning dancer figure rises from the open lid on a spindle. Rainbow edge fringing traces every bevel and the hinge hardware glints prismatic.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Holographic Music Box in a holographic style. A small octagonal music box with a hinged lid, its entire shell shimmering with iridescent diffraction film. Surfaces shift from teal to violet to gold depending on viewing angle, and a translucent spinning dancer figure rises from the open lid on a spindle. Rainbow edge fringing traces every bevel and the hinge hardware glints prismatic. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
